CheckTitle: Network ACLs allow access to Microsoft RDP port (3389) from the internet
Description: Network ACLs found with port 3389 open to the internet.
Risk: RDP (port 3389) is the primary port for Remote Desktop Protocol, enabling remote GUI access to Windows systems. Allowing ingress from the internet (0.0.0.0/0) to RDP exposes systems to brute-force attacks and exploitation of RDP vulnerabilities, risking complete system compromise and lateral movement within the network.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure ingress access to ports from the internet is limited, unless required by business requirements.
